name: brain
description: Shared, permissioned, versioned knowledge base and messaging for AI agents and people (MCP server + web UI)

scripts.dev:web: npm run web:install && npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build:web: npm run web:install && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.ci:web: npm run web:install && npm --prefix web run ci
scripts.screenshots: npm run web:install && { [ -f web/dist/index.html ] && [ -z "$(find web/src web/index.html web/package-lock.json -newer web/dist/index.html -print -quit)" ] || npm --prefix web run build; } && npm --prefix web run screenshots
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run contract-check && npm run ci:web
